title: Questions
metaDescription: Answers on placing an order, shipping from Spain to the UK and EU, the {withdrawalDays}-day cancellation window, card payment, looking after what you buy, and your {brand} account.
lead: Quick answers to what we are asked most. The binding detail sits in our <policies>policies</policies>.
stillNeedHelpBody: Send us a message and you will hear back {replyTime}. We are at the desk {supportHours}.

place.q: How do I place an order?
place.a: Fill the bag, open the checkout, give us your contact and delivery details, read the order back, then pay on our provider's secure page. The confirmation email goes out the moment that payment is confirmed to us.

guest.q: Do I need an account to order?
guest.a: Not at all — guest checkout works fine. An account simply keeps your order history, your bookmarked products and your details ready for next time.

change.q: Can I change or cancel my order?
change.a: Email us the order number as early as you can. Still in the warehouse, and we pull it and refund everything. Already gone, and you have {withdrawalDays} days from delivery to cancel instead, as the <returns>Returns and refunds policy</returns> explains.

limits.q: Is there a limit on how many I can buy?
limits.a: One order holds up to {maxQty} of any single product, and {maxItems} items in total.

noEmail.q: I have paid and no confirmation email arrived.
noEmail.a: Look in spam and promotions first. We only send the confirmation once the payment provider has confirmed the payment. Card charged and still nothing after that, and we want to hear from you — quote the email address you used.

where.q: Which countries do you ship to?
where.a: The {countries}. Outside that: {restricted}, and the temporarily occupied territories of Ukraine.

from.q: Where does my parcel start from?
from.a: Everything is packed at {dispatchFrom} and leaves within {processingDays} of the payment clearing.

time.a: Reckon on {deliveryEu} for EU addresses and {deliveryUk} for the United Kingdom. Carrier estimates, not fixed dates.

cost.a: {deliveryCost} on an order, dropping to nothing once the order reaches {freeThreshold}. You see it at checkout before paying.

duties.q: Are there import charges for UK deliveries?

tracking.a: Dispatch triggers an email, carrying a tracking number wherever the carrier issues one. Account holders can also see the status under Your orders.

can.q: Can I send something back if I change my mind?
can.a: Yes — {withdrawalDays} days from the parcel arriving, no reason needed, and then {returnShipDays} days to get the goods posted. Tell us by email or through the contact form before you send anything.

postage.a: You do on a change of mind. Faulty, damaged or simply the wrong item, and it is on us.

refund.q: How soon does the money come back?
refund.a: Inside {refundDays} days of the goods reaching us, or of your proof of posting if that comes first. It returns to the paying card in the paying currency.

used.q: What if I have already used it?
used.a: Unbox it and check it over as you would in a shop. Once a bowl has been fed from, a bed slept on, a tray filled or a tank filled with water, we may deduct the value lost. A faulty item is always refunded in full.

damaged.a: Email the order number with photographs of the goods and the packaging. A replacement or a refund follows, and it costs you nothing.

methods.a: A {cardMethods} card. The details are typed into the hosted page of our PCI DSS compliant payment provider. We take nothing else.

safe.a: Full card data is never stored or processed here — our PCI DSS compliant provider handles every payment. Your bank may ask you to confirm it through 3-D Secure, usually in its app.

currencies.a: {currencies}. The charge is taken in whichever one you had selected at checkout. A card held in another currency may attract your bank's conversion fee.

vatNo.a: {company} holds no VAT registration, so there is no VAT to charge and none is added at checkout.

vatYes.a: It is — the applicable VAT rate is already inside the price you see.

when.q: At what point am I charged?
when.a: When you finish the payment on the provider's page. Declined or abandoned, and no order exists and no money moves.

range.a: Food, treats, bedding, bowls and feeders, collars, harnesses and leads, grooming tools, litter trays and litter, cages, hutches and kennels, carriers, aquarium equipment and decoration, and terrarium habitat, heating and lighting. No live animals, and no prescription-only veterinary medicines.

suitability.q: How do I tell whether something will fit my animal?
suitability.a: Each product page carries the materials, the measurements and the care notes we hold — chest girth and neck ranges on walking kit, internal dimensions on cages and carriers, tank volume on filters and heaters. Measure your animal with a soft tape and read it against those figures rather than against a breed name.

care.q: Anything I should know about looking after what I buy?
care.a: Webbing: hand wash and air dry, and check buckles and stitching before each walk. Cages and trays: hot water and a rinse-off animal-safe cleaner, dried before refilling. Aquarium filters: rinse the media in water taken out of the tank, never under the tap. Reptile UVB lamps: replace on the stated interval, whether or not they still light.

warranty.q: Is anything covered by a warranty?
warranty.a: Yes — {warrantyMonths} months against manufacturing defects on everything we sell, on top of your statutory rights. The <warranty>Warranty</warranty> sets out what is in, what is out and how to claim.

who.a: Anyone of {minAge} or over living in a country we deliver to. Date of birth is asked for at registration.

password.a: Use "Forgot your password?" on the sign-in page and give us the email address. Where an account exists for it, a link to set a new password follows.

delete.q: How do I close my account or remove my data?
delete.a: Email {email} from the address the account is under. We close it and delete your data, keeping only the order records the law obliges us to hold — the <privacy>Privacy policy</privacy> has the detail.

newsletter.q: How do I stop the emails?
newsletter.a: Email {email} and the address comes off the newsletter list. Order and account emails carry on, since they are part of the order itself.
